sections.title: Vanaduspensioni tingimused
sections.body: Old-age pension eligibility: age 65 + minimum 15 years of pension-qualifying service in Estonia. From 2027, age adjusts annually based on life expectancy.

sections.title: Paindlik pension
sections.body: Flexible retirement: may claim up to 5 years early (with reduced amount) or delay (with increased amount).

sections.title: Soodustingimustel vanaduspension
sections.body: Early retirement for 40+ years of contributions: up to 5 years before standard age, without reduction.

sections.title: Pensioni arvutamine
sections.body: Pension components: base part, service-years component, insurance portion, combined portion. Annual indexing applies.

sections.title: Rahvapension
sections.body: Universal pension (national pension) for elderly with insufficient contributions. Requires 5 years immediate residence in Estonia before claim.

sections.title: Töövõimetuspension
sections.body: Disability pension (now replaced by work ability allowance under Töövõimetoetuse seadus for new claims since 2016).

sections.title: Toitjakaotuspension
sections.body: Survivor pension: 50-100% of deceased's theoretical benefit, depending on household size.

sections.title: Pensioni määramine
sections.body: Pension determined by Sotsiaalkindlustusamet (Social Insurance Board).

sections.title: Otsuse vaidlustamine
sections.body: Appeal pension decision within 30 days to Sotsiaalkindlustusamet; further to halduskohus.
